# dsh-roam-planner

Trip planning inside DeepSeek Harness: talk a plan
into existence, watch it land on a map, and adopt
it when it looks right.

The agent edits a **draft**. A candidate is frozen for review, and only an explicit
**Adopt** commit

s it — so a hallucinated revision can never overwrite a plan you
already accepted.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `^0.2.1-rc.2` (`engines.dsh`)
- No extra services: no Docker, no database, no API

rness `^0.2.1-rc.2` (`engines.dsh`)
- No extra services: no Docker, no database, no API key required
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then **restart DSH**: the host half loads its tools and `/roam/api` routes at
startup. After the res

tart the sidebar shows a **Roam Planner** icon, and the
agent gains the `roam_*` tools.
## First run

1. Click the sidebar icon — an empty panel says to ask the agent for a plan.
2. In any conversation:
> Plan two relaxed days in Suzhou for me and my parents

3. The agent calls `roam_get_snapshot`, `roam_prepare_draft` (place **names**
only — the host geocod

es them) and `roam_fill_routes`. The panel polls every
few seconds and follows along.
4. `roam_save_

candidate` freezes the plan; a green **Adopt plan** button appears.
5. Adopt it. Editing afterwards

reopens a draft, and the panel shows what
changed against the adopted version.
## Optional: Amap key

Place lookup and routing work without a key (OpenStreetMap + OSRM), but Chinese
addresses resolve fa
r better through Amap.

**Settings → Roam Planner → Amap Web-service key** (not a JS API key). The key is
written to the hos

t credential store under `ROAM_PLANNER_AMAP_KEY`, is never sent
back to the page, and takes effect o
n the next lookup — no restart.
## Configuration
Everything below lives in the plugin row's `config` in `cordis.patch.yml`:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `basemapId` | `osm` | Basemap selected on first use |
| `basemaps` | `null` | Replacement provider

catalogue (array of `{id, label, url, attribution, maxZoom, crs}`); `null` uses the built-ins |
| `

geocoder` | `nominatim` | `nominatim`, `amap`, or `off` |
| `amapKey` | `null` | Deployment-level ke

y; a key saved in Settings wins |
| `defaultCity` | `null` | City appended to place names, e.g. `苏州`

|
| `dataDir` | `null` | Directory for the JSON fallback store |
## External MCP sidecars (optional)

Railway tickets and Xiaohongshu notes are not built in. The plugin speaks MCP
itself — `stdio` and `

streamable http` — so any sidecar can be attached through
config, and servers start on the first cal
l rather than at activation.

The agent reaches them through `roam_mcp_servers`, `roam_mcp_tools` and
`roam_mcp_call`.
### Railway: use the bundled proxy

`server/railway-mcp.js` is our own MCP server in front of the third-party 12306
sidecar. It owns the

railway business API, so the caller gets a time window, a
station filter and a row cap instead of a
n entire day of trains:
| Parameter | Meaning |

| `from_station`, `to_station`, `date` | The query itself (`date` = YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `time_from`, `ti

me_to` | Departure window, `HH:MM` |
| `station` | Keep trains serving this station (a city has many

) |
| `limit` | Maximum trains returned, default 10, max 50 |
[代码示例省略，未执行]

A raw `streamable http` sidecar is configured with `transport: http` and
`url`. Add `command` (plus

optional `args`/`env`) and the bridge starts
the process on first use, waits for the port and then s

peaks HTTP — nothing has
to be launched by hand.
| Sidecar | Source | Notes |

| 12306 tickets | drfccv/mcp-server-12306 | The project states non-commercial use only |
| Xiaohongs
hu notes | xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp | Needs a one-time login; serves HTTP on `:18060` |
## Tools
| Tool | Effect |

| `roam_get_snapshot` | Read the session trip (creates an empty draft if none) |
| `roam_prepare_dra

ft` | Apply a title/days change; stops need only a name |
| `roam_save_candidate` | Freeze the draft

for review |
| `roam_adopt` | Commit the candidate |
| `roam_fill_routes` | Fill missing leg geomet

ry and durations (Amap or OSRM) |
| `roam_forecast` | Daily weather at each day's first stop (read-o

nly) |
| `roam_search_places` | Keyword search for real places (needs an Amap key) |
| `roam_mcp_ser
vers` / `roam_mcp_tools` / `roam_mcp_call` | Reach an attached MCP sidecar |
## Data

- Trips live in the DSH storage domain (`$DSH_HOME/storages/roam_planner.json`),
falling back to `<d

ataDir>/.roam/store.json` when the domain is unavailable.
- The Amap key lives in the credential sto

re, never in the trip data.
- The page remembers the chosen basemap locally; that is a viewing prefe

rence,
not trip data.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Cause / fix |

| Panel says the host routes are unavailable | The host half failed to activate — restart DSH |
| Ma

p is blank but the day list renders | Basemap tiles could not load (network or provider policy) |
|

Routes are straight dashed lines | No route source answered; fill them with `roam_fill_routes` |
| W
eather chips missing | The forecast has no data for those dates yet |
